reviews.author: Mahesh Babu
reviews.text:
**Review for Doctor Ramesh**

I had an extremely disappointing and alarming experience with Dr. Ramesh. I initially visited him for an itching issue, and he immediately suggested a barrage of tests, which I later realized were unnecessary and likely a way for him to earn a commission. To my shock, he diagnosed me with psoriasis without any proper examination or evidence.

When I showed him a corn on my foot, he quickly blamed it on psoriasis as well. However, the corn was easily treated with a simple ₹50 Corn Cap. It became clear that his go-to diagnosis for any issue is psoriasis, and he prescribed a lot of expensive tests and medicines, undoubtedly for his own financial gain.

After fleeing from his clinic, I consulted another reputable doctor in Guntur, who correctly identified my issue as a simple fungal infection, which was treated quickly and effectively. Had I followed Dr. Ramesh’s advice, I could have ended up taking unnecessary and potentially harmful psoriasis medication, causing undue stress and mental anguish.

In my opinion, Dr. Ramesh is more interested in profit than in the well-being of his patients. His reckless and baseless diagnoses could easily ruin lives. I strongly advise against visiting this doctor. Even a roadside herbal vendor would provide better and more honest care.
